summary: Janus Living, Inc., a Maryland REIT, filed an 8-K reporting a routine registered underwritten public offering that closed November 6, 2026: 30,187,500 shares of Class A-1 common stock, including full exercise of the underwriters' 3,937,500-share option, sold under its Form S-11 registration statements. The underwriting agreement dated November 4, 2026 was entered among the Company, Janus Living OP, LLC, external manager Healthpeak Investment Management, LLC, and representatives BofA, J.P. Morgan, Wells Fargo and Goldman Sachs. No price, premium or special-situation terms were disclosed; this is an ordinary primary equity takedown, not a special situation.
